reviews.text:
Love This App!. The Bible is one of the most influential and widely read books in history, serving as a foundational text for Christianity and shaping cultures, laws, and philosophies worldwide. It is divided into two primary sections: the Old Testament and the New Testament.

Old Testament

The Old Testament, also recognized in Judaism as the Hebrew Bible, contains books such as Genesis, Psalms, and Isaiah. It chronicles the creation of the world, God’s covenant with the people of Israel, and the laws and prophecies given through figures like Moses and Elijah. It highlights themes of faith, obedience, and God’s plan for humanity.

New Testament

The New Testament focuses on the life, teachings, death, and resurrection of Jesus Christ, central to Christian belief. Books like the Gospels (Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John) detail His ministry, while the Acts of the Apostles and the Epistles (letters written by apostles like Paul) emphasize the growth of the early church and Christian theology. Revelation concludes with a prophetic vision of the end times and the promise of eternal life.

Themes

The Bible conveys themes of love, redemption, justice, mercy, and the relationship between God and humanity. It encourages reflection on morality, purpose, and faith.

Impact

The Bible is not only a religious text but also a literary masterpiece, inspiring art, music, and literature. It is revered for its spiritual guidance and ethical teachings.

Many find the Bible to be a source of comfort and direction, though interpretations and applications vary. It remains a timeless guide for millions seeking to understand their faith and the world.

reviews.text:
03-Apr-20 - Curious package, compatibility issues. 03-Apr-20: There are two Shukalovich multi-version Bibles, both named "Holy Bible for Daily Reading." This one is by Nataliia Shukalovich, the other is by Tatsiana Shukalovich. Also, the Tatsiana version appears to have topped out at version 7.5, the Nataliia is at version 7.5.1.

It appears that both versions contain the same selection of Bibles. (Could the Nataliia version be a revision or replacement for the Tatsiana version?)

Issues: Both versions claim compatibility for iOS 9. However, the newer version, Nataliia's, version 7.5.1 will load on iOS 9, but the main menus of table of contents and settings (where different Bibles can be selected) do not work. This means that, in iOS 9, the Nataliia version, 7.5.1, does not work.

The second issue: I like one Bible app with several editions of the Bible. And this app certainly has a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. But it is a strange selection, containing the Elberfelder German Bible, but not the Luther German Bible.

I would recommend adding three Bibles: The Luther Bible, the Herder Bible (also German), and the Latin Bible. The Luther (Protestant) and Herder (Catholic) Bibles are the standard German language Bibles. The Latin Bible is what the CPDV Bible was translated from. (They also happen to be the three Bibles I am studying at this time)

I wouldn't recommend deleting any of the Bibles, surely there was reason to include all of them in the first place. But I was surprised to see at least three other Bibles that would be of interest to a more general readership.
